title: Agno and Mastra — What Production Agent Runtimes Provide
titleKn: Agno ಮತ್ತು Mastra — ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ Agent Runtimes ಏನು ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ
desc: What a production runtime adds beyond a loop: storage, memory, workflows, evals and deployment, and how to choose one.
objectives: List capabilities a production runtime should provide.
Apply criteria for choosing a framework.
objectivesKn: ಉತ್ಪಾದನಾ runtime ನೀಡಬೇಕಾದ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.

title: Agno and Mastra — Workflows, Memory and Knowledge in Practice
titleKn: Agno ಮತ್ತು Mastra — ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕವಾಗಿ Workflows, Memory, Knowledge
desc: How workflows orchestrate steps, how memory and knowledge differ, and how each is kept correct over time.
objectives: Describe workflows as steps with branching and retries.
Distinguish memory of interactions from a knowledge base.
Explain how to keep knowledge fresh.

[{"type":"heading","data":{"textEn":"Agno and Mastra — Workflows, Memory and Knowledge in Practice","textKn":"Agno and Mastra — Workflows, Memory and Knowledge in Practice","level":"H1"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Lesson Info","headingKn":"Lesson ಮಾಹಿತಿ","bodyEn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 minutes · Part 2 of 3 in Agno and Mastra: Production Runtimes","bodyKn":"• Type: Concept · Time: ~25 ನಿಮಿಷಗಳು · Part 2 of 3"}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Workflows","headingKn":"Workflows","bodyEn":"A workflow defines steps, their order, branches, parallel parts and retry behaviour, with an agent or plain code in each step. It makes a multi-step process repeatable and observable.","bodyKn":"workflow ಹಂತಗಳು, ಕ್ರಮ, ಶಾಖೆಗಳು, ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ಭಾಗಗಳು, ಮರುಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ವರ್ತನೆ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ agent ಅಥವಾ ಕೋಡ್. ಬಹು-ಹಂತ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೀಯ ಮತ್ತು ವೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬಹುದಾದ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Memory Versus Knowledge","headingKn":"Memory vs Knowledge","bodyEn":"Memory holds what happened in interactions with a user, such as preferences and past requests. Knowledge is a curated body of documents the agent retrieves from. They have different owners and update patterns.","bodyKn":"memory ಬಳಕೆದಾರರೊಂದಿಗಿನ ಸಂವಾದದಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆದದ್ದನ್ನು (ಆದ್ಯತೆ, ಹಿಂದಿನ ವಿನಂತಿ) ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. knowledge agent ಹಿಂಪಡೆಯುವ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು. ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಮತ್ತು ನವೀಕರಣ ಮಾದರಿ ಬೇರೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Freshness of Knowledge","headingKn":"Knowledge ಹೊಸತನ","bodyEn":"Documents change, so a knowledge base needs re-ingestion, deletion of removed sources and a way to see when each item was indexed. Stale knowledge produces confident wrong answers.","bodyKn":"ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಮರು-ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ, ತೆಗೆದ ಮೂಲಗಳ ಅಳಿಸುವಿಕೆ, ಪ್ರತಿ ಐಟಂ ಯಾವಾಗ ಇಂಡೆಕ್ಸ್ ಆಯಿತು ಎಂದು ನೋಡುವ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಬೇಕು. ಹಳೆಯ ಜ್ಞಾನ ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದ ತಪ್ಪು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Test Retrieval Separately","headingKn":"Retrieval ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ","bodyEn":"Check that the right documents are retrieved before judging the final answer. A wrong answer with good retrieval is a prompt problem; with bad retrieval it is a search problem.","bodyKn":"ಅಂತಿಮ ಉತ್ತರ ನಿರ್ಣಯಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಿಯಾದ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳು ಬಂದಿವೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಉತ್ತಮ retrieval ನಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪು ಉತ್ತರ prompt ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ; ಕೆಟ್ಟ retrieval ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ."}},{"type":"concept","data":{"headingEn":"Key Takeaways","headingKn":"ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳು","bodyEn":"• Workflows make multi-step processes repeatable.
• Memory is about interactions; knowledge is a curated corpus.
• Keep knowledge fresh and test retrieval on its own.","bodyKn":"• workflows ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೀಯ.
• memory ಸಂವಾದ; knowledge ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ದಾಖಲೆ.
• ಹೊಸತನ ಮತ್ತು retrieval ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ."}},{"type":"quiz","data":{"questions":[{"q":"What is the difference between memory and knowledge?","qKn":"memory ಮತ್ತು knowledge ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ?","opts":["Memory is about interactions; knowledge is a curated document set","They are identical","Knowledge is only for users","Memory is only code"],"optsKn":["memory ಸಂವಾದ; knowledge ದಾಖಲೆ ಸೆಟ್","ಒಂದೇ","knowledge ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ","memory ಕೋಡ್ ಮಾತ್ರ"],"correct":0},{"q":"Why test retrieval separately?","qKn":"retrieval ಅನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಏಕೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಬೇಕು?","opts":["To tell search problems from prompt problems","To skip answers","It is faster to ignore","Retrieval is random"],"optsKn":["ಹುಡುಕಾಟ ಮತ್ತು prompt ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಲು","ಉತ್ತರ ಬಿಡಲು","ನಿರ್ಲಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದು ವೇಗ","ಯಾದೃಚ್ಛಿಕ"],"correct":0},{"q":"What does stale knowledge cause?","qKn":"ಹಳೆಯ knowledge ಏನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ?","opts":["Confident wrong answers","Faster answers","Smaller prompts","Nothing"],"optsKn":["ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸದ ತಪ್ಪು ಉತ್ತರ","ವೇಗ ಉತ್ತರ","ಚಿಕ್ಕ prompts","ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ"],"correct":0}]}}]
